children: Blue Owl Capital entered into a Fourth Amendment to its amended and restated revolving credit facility to boost total commitments to $3.225 billion, with an option to increase to $3.87 billion subject to conditions. The amendment, arranged with MUFG Bank as administrative agent and a syndicate of lenders, lowers interest margins and commitment fees and extends the facility’s maturity to October 14, 2031. The changes are expected to enhance liquidity and reduce borrowing costs.
